sources.title: Hi-WM: Human-in-the-World-Model for Scalable Robot Post-Training
sources.snippet: Meanwhile, action-conditioned world models have been studied mainly for imagination, synthetic data generation, and policy evaluation. We propose \textbf{Human-in-the-World-Model (Hi-WM)}, a post-training framework that uses a learned world model as a reusable corrective substrate for failure-targeted policy improvement.
